boundary: Widgets of a special background's stage-effect prefab (InGameStageBgEffector, instantiated by InGameStageManager.setupForSpecialBgSkin) that are visible during play: active, final NGUI alpha > 0, not clipped or depth-cut. Only skin_delta and skin_collabo23_winter_d have such widgets (speakerRoot/speaker_L and speaker_R); every other background's stage effect is empty, invisible during play, or a one-shot particle burst at load (skin_maid). Coordinates are the prefab root's space, taken as the stage TRSRoot space (x right, y up; widget centre and size); the texture is the background bundle's Texture2D of that name, stretched to the widget size, white, normal alpha blending.
assumption: Render order: the widgets draw in the panel above InGameStageManager+0x30, whose render queue is not in the evidence. They are drawn with the stage directly above the background image, so BgCover and the queue-3490 DarkCover subtraction cover them like the rest of the stage; the prefab's own panels (queue 3100-3250) are below DarkCover as well.
